$comment: EPUB import and export (feature 012): the File > Import and File > Export entries, File > Open's refusal of an EPUB, the import's and the export's messages, progress and summaries. Feature catalogue merged into en.json by i18n/index.ts.

importEpub.description: Make a new book from an EPUB book of any version up to 3.3: its chapters, notes and pictures come along, best effort

exportEpub.description: Write the book as a valid EPUB 3.3 file that older reading devices can open too

epub.openRefused: {{path}} is an EPUB book. File > Open takes FictionBook (FB2) books, FBD files and ZIP archives holding FB2 books; an EPUB book is imported with File > Import > EPUB File....
epub.exportDone: Exported to {{path}}: {{pages}} pages, {{pictures}} pictures, {{tables}} tables, {{notes}} notes.
epub.exportCancelled: The export was cancelled; no file was written.
epub.exportSummaryIntro: Not everything was carried over as written:

summary.stylesheetDropped: Stylesheet that is not CSS left out: {{detail}}
summary.idMadeUnique: Id used more than once, made unique in the file: {{detail}}

writeFailed.badName: A file name inside the EPUB is not valid.
writeFailed.targetIsSource: {{path}} is the book's own file; choose another name.
writeFailed.unknownToken: The export lost its file; try again.
writeFailed.ioError: The file could not be written.

epub.importDone: Imported from EPUB: {{sections}} sections, {{pictures}} pictures, {{tables}} tables, {{notes}} notes.
epub.importCancelled: The import was cancelled; the book in the window is unchanged.
epub.importSummaryIntro: Not everything came over as written:

importSummary.linkAsText: Link to a place that does not exist, written as text: {{detail}}
importSummary.remote: Resource on the web, not fetched: {{detail}}
importSummary.dropped: Left out (FB2 has no place for it): {{detail}}
importSummary.recovered: Page that is not well-formed, read as HTML: {{detail}}
importSummary.unreadable: Part of the book that could not be read: {{detail}}
importSummary.outside: File named outside the book, not read: {{detail}}
importSummary.pageMissing: Page the reading order names but the book does not hold: {{detail}}
importSummary.pictureConverted: Picture converted to JPEG or PNG: {{detail}}
importSummary.pictureTooLarge: Picture larger than 100 megapixels, not added: {{detail}}
importSummary.formulaAsText: Formula that could not be drawn, kept as its text: {{detail}}
importSummary.drawingLeftOut: Drawing that could not be drawn, left out: {{detail}}
importSummary.droppedChar: Character no bundled font draws (a private-use character of the book's own font), left out: {{detail}}
importSummary.nestingFlattened: Nesting deeper than {{detail}} levels, flattened into paragraphs
importSummary.cssDropped: Style the book's look could not use, left out: {{detail}}
importSummary.droppedMedia: Audio and video, left out (their text and poster picture kept): {{detail}}
importSummary.droppedScripts: Scripts, left out and never run: {{detail}}
importSummary.droppedForms: Forms and interactive parts, left out: {{detail}}
importSummary.droppedEmbedded: Embedded objects and canvases, left out: {{detail}}
importSummary.droppedPageList: The list of the print edition's pages, left out
importSummary.droppedFixedLayout: The positions of the fixed-layout pages, left out: their text and pictures come in reading order

refused.notZip: it is not an EPUB book (not a ZIP archive).
refused.noPackage: it is not an EPUB book (it has no package document).
refused.protected: the book is protected (DRM) and cannot be imported.
refused.tooLarge: the file is larger than the import reads (512 MB).
refused.zipBomb: the archive unpacks to far more than it holds and is not read.
refused.tooManyEntries: the archive holds too many files.
refused.encryptedZip: the archive is protected by a password.
